[P1] Propagate branch identity mismatches instead of recording them as branch failures

This can raise `NonDeterministicExecutionError` from a worker, but `_branch_worker` converts every `Exception` into a normal failed item; flat replay does likewise. With tolerated failures or a custom completion policy, map/parallel can consequently checkpoint success after detecting nondeterministic history. Route this error through the fatal/re-raise path, explicitly re-raise it during flat replay, and test both nesting modes.
